messages:
alex_truong: Quick async check — I'm about to run an int4 + fp8 pass against the new promptset that surfaces edge cases (long tails / repeated tokens). Wanted to align on: (1) which prompts we should flag as MUST-PASS qualitatively, (2) perf windows to watch for, and (3) whether we gate on delta >= X for ppl/approx-similarity. Link to PR and sample prompts: https://stash.redwood.ai/p/edge-promptset (PR #2413).

maya_k: thanks — can you paste 3–5 seed prompts here? easier to eyeball. also do we want to include the few adversarial paraphrases from last quarter?

alex_truong: pasted three below. yes include the paraphrases. also add the long stream example (~4k tokens) and a repetition-heavy prompt.

alex_truong: "PromptA: summarize long policymemo with nested bullets and references; keep factual claims only."

alex_truong: "PromptB: developer chat that includes many repeated tokens and code blocks: repeat 'foo()' with small edits 200x."

alex_truong: "PromptC: instruction-following with subtle negation changes (don't X vs avoid X)."

ryan_o: I can run the bench today. quick Q — which model variant? int4 on baseline kernels + fp8 for attention only? or fp8 everywhere? small/medium/large?

alex_truong: start with: baseline-llama-13b (fp32) -> int4-quant (our default kernels) -> hybrid-int4+fp8-attn (fp8 for attention ops only). run small/medium seeds for perf, but the longstream on large if you have capacity.

jamie: for gating, we agreed on per-prompt quality thresholds: sim >= 0.92 average OR no catastrophic hallucination on correctness checks. we also have a rule of thumb: latency increase <= 1.2x to pass for canary. that was from the last quant playbook.

quant_samantha: heads up — for the negation prompt (PromptC) our evals showed a brittle pattern when we moved attn to fp8 in the copy of Llama-13B last month: precision drop on negation tests around ~6% relative. If you see that, call it out. We should capture example outputs (gold vs sample) in the artifact.

ryan_o: running CI job now. command I use: ```./bench/run_quant_compare.sh --model llama-13b --variants int4,hybrid-fp8 --prompts prompts/edgecases.txt --metrics ppl,sim,exact-match --out s3://redwood-bench/1918887770/``` will post results.

infra-bot: CI job queued: bench-1918887770. Estimated runtime 45m. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/bench-1918887770

maya_k: quick ask — can we include one qualitative human check for PromptA? maybe jamie or samantha can eyeball 10 samples. automation isn't enough for subtle factuality.

jamie: I can eyeball PromptA samples after the run. ping me with the artifact link.

ryan_o: run finished (45m). uploading artifacts. summary: int4 vs baseline -> sim delta -0.015 average; hybrid-fp8-attn vs int4 -> sim delta -0.003. latency: int4 0.95x baseline (slightly faster), hybrid-fp8-attn 1.18x baseline on 13B seq512. full logs: s3://redwood-bench/1918887770/results.json

infra-bot: Upload complete. artifacts available: s3://redwood-bench/1918887770/ (results.json, diffs/, samples/).

quant_samantha: pulling samples now. initial look — PromptC shows the expected negation regress: hybrid-fp8-attn produces an incorrect affirmative in 9/100 samples vs 3/100 for int4. need to check whether it's a distribution/attention-scale effect or a numeric noise issue.

alex_truong: thanks. can you paste one example pair (gold vs hybrid output) for triage?

quant_samantha: example:
- gold: "Do not include user's private data in the summary."
- hybrid-fp8 output: "Include the user's private data in the summary."

quant_samantha: tagging it as HIGH for quality. adding to the regression board: https://triage.redwood.ai/regressions/1918887770

ryan_o: curious — latency looks within canary but quality fails PromptC. we should prob test fp8-only-attn with an adjusted scale (tweak layernorm/attn-scale hyper). I'll spin a microbench with different quant scales.

maya_k: also worth measuring tail latency on the longstream prompt. sometimes fp8 causes kv-cache churn that spikes 95th pct. can you add p95/p99?

ryan_o: good call — I'll add p50/p95/p99 to the next run. command tweak: ```--metrics ppl,sim,exact-match,p50,p95,p99```

jamie: decision item: Do we block canary for hybrid-fp8-attn on 13B until PromptC passes with corrected scaling? or ship with fallback to int4 for negation-sensitive routes?

alex_truong: proposal: block canary for hybrid-fp8-attn on default route. allow opt-in for experimental routes (with disclaimer and fallback to int4 if sim drops below 0.9). open to other suggestions.

quant_samantha: agree with block. we should also run a small ablation to confirm if changing attention scaling fixes it — if so, we can make it a config knob rather than rollback.

ryan_o: starting microbench with two scale settings now. will post results in this thread. ETA ~30m.

infra-bot: microbench job queued: micro-1918887770-scale-test. ETA 30m.

alex_truong: ty all. please drop artifacts and callouts here. if someone can craft a short release note blurb for the block (product-facing), ping me and i'll help phrase it. :rocket:

maya_k: I'll draft the blurb once we confirm regression cause.

ryan_o: microbench results uploaded. scale=0.98 reduces negation failures to 4/100 for hybrid-fp8. throughput cost +3% vs previous hybrid setting. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/1918887770/micro-scale/

quant_samantha: promising. still want a couple more seeds and a human check, but this is in the right direction.

jamie: ok — interim plan: keep canary blocked for hybrid-fp8-attn on default route. allow opt-in with scale=0.98 in a controlled experiment for internal teams. Ryan, can you prepare a PR with the scale knob + tests?

ryan_o: on it (PR incoming).

alex_truong: great work. please add a short note in the PR that links this thread and the regression ticket. i'll follow up with stakeholders tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maya_k: ping when PR is ready and i'll run the human checks for PromptA/C.

quant_samantha: tagging in the regression ticket and adding the example pairs.

alex_truong: closing the loop here, will update the rollout doc once PR lands. Thanks everyone.
